records.name: John Yudichak
records.notes: Current president per Wikipedia infobox; a former Pennsylvania state senator. LCCC's own website (luzerne.edu) returned server errors (403/redirect loops) during this research session, so the exact appointment date and predecessor could not be independently confirmed via primary sources. Additional verification of start year and prior leadership recommended.

records.name: Andrea D. Daniel
records.notes: Current president (Dr. Andrea D. Daniel), confirmed via Wikipedia and the college's own site (athenstech.edu news references her as president through 2026). Exact start date and predecessor could not be confirmed this session; the college's presidents-bio/message pages returned 404 errors during research.

records.name: Kendricks D. Hooker
records.notes: Dr. Hooker describes himself as 'honored to serve as the new president' on the college's official presidents-message page, indicating a recent appointment (circa 2025/2026). Prior roles include Provost at Cabarrus College of Health Sciences, VP of Academic Affairs at Southwest Tennessee Community College, and dean roles at Madison Area Technical College.

records.name: Jermaine Whirl
records.notes: Immediate predecessor to Hooker, per Wikipedia infobox (listed as president prior to the site update showing Hooker). Exact tenure start/end dates not independently confirmed this session.

records.name: Laura McCullough
records.notes: Current president (Dr. Laura McCullough), part of the Kentucky Community and Technical College System (KCTCS). A KSL news archive references 'New president named at Maysville Community College' but the article predates confirmation and could not be tied definitively to a named predecessor this session. MCTC's own site (maysville.kctcs.edu) returned 404s for the about/president pages attempted.

records.name: James Preston
records.notes: Current president of West Hills College Lemoore (part of the West Hills Community College District, under a district Chancellor). Predecessor and exact start date could not be confirmed this session; the college's own president pages (westhillscollege.com/lemoore, lemoorecollege.edu) redirected repeatedly or 404'd.

records.name: Joel Hagood
records.notes: Dr. Joel Hagood was appointed president in November 2020 per the college's official announcement (referenced via Wikipedia) and remains president as of 2026 per recent Daily Mountain Eagle coverage. Predecessor not confirmed this session; the college's president/about pages (bscc.edu) returned repeated 503 errors.

records.name: Debra L. McCurdy
records.notes: Current president per BCCC's official Office of the President page. A May 2026 Daily Record article on faculty labor disputes confirms she remains president and describes her compensation, but exact start date not stated in accessible sources.

records.name: Gordon F. May
records.notes: Appointed president and CEO following the interim period after Carolane Williams's removal, per Wikipedia. End date of his tenure not confirmed this session.

records.name: Carolyn Hull Anderson
records.notes: Served as interim president following Carolane Williams's removal in December 2012.

records.name: Carolane Williams
records.notes: Removed as president in December 2012 by the board of trustees after a 2010 faculty 'no confidence' vote; Maryland Gov. Martin O'Malley subsequently replaced most of BCCC's board amid accreditation/governance issues.

records.name: Sunil Ahuja
records.priorTitle: Provost and Vice President for Academic and Student Affairs
records.notes: Current president; the Board of Trustees recently voted to extend his contract through June 2030 (per The News-Herald, 2026), indicating he has served for several years already. Prior to Lakeland, he was provost/VP for academic and student affairs at Shawnee State University, and earlier associate provost at University of Scranton, VP for accreditation relations at the Higher Learning Commission, and dean at Lorain County Community College. Exact year he became Lakeland's president was not confirmable this session (lakelandcc.edu president history pages did not list a start date).

records.name: Ralph Doty
records.notes: A former Lakeland Community College president, whose death was noted in a 2020 news article ('Former Lakeland Community College president Ralph Doty remembered'). Not confirmed whether he was the immediate predecessor to Ahuja; exact tenure dates unavailable via accessible sources this session.

records.name: Greg Pereira
records.notes: Current president, confirmed via Wikipedia and a 2026 KTVZ article covering his 'State of the College' address. Predecessor and exact start date not confirmed this session; cocc.edu's leadership/president pages returned 503 errors during research.

records.name: Jeremy (J.P.) McMillen
records.notes: Current president per the college's official President's Page (welcome message references a recent bond approval and campus development). Predecessor and exact start date not confirmed this session; the college's history page (grayson.edu/about-us/history) returned a 404.

records.name: Kevin Brockbank
records.notes: Listed as president in Wikipedia's Spokane Falls Community College infobox, though the related Community Colleges of Spokane article describes him as 'Chancellor' of the overall two-college district (which includes Spokane Falls CC and Spokane CC) -- this district structure means the top leadership title/scope needs verification directly with the college. Predecessor not confirmed; sfcc.spokane.edu and spokanefalls.edu pages could not be retrieved (403/domain verification errors) this session.

records.name: Jenny Varner
records.notes: Current president per the college's leadership listing. Exact start date not confirmed this session; the college's Office of the President page (davidsondavie.edu) returned 403 errors.

records.name: Darrin Hartness
records.notes: Sworn in as the college's fourth president on January 2, 2019, per Wikipedia. Presumed immediate predecessor to Varner, though this was not independently confirmed via the college's own site this session.

records.name: Jason Smith
records.notes: Named Texarkana College's ninth president effective January 1, 2019, per the college's own history page. Formerly superintendent of Pleasant Grove ISD.

records.name: James Henry Russell
records.notes: Eighth president, took office June 2011; solicited a $5 million matching donation from alumnus Ross Perot in 2011 to help address the institution's financial challenges.

records.name: Alan Rasco
records.notes: Served as president from February 2009 to 2011, per the college's official history page.

records.name: Frank Coleman
records.notes: Became permanent president in July 2002, succeeding Dr. Carl M. Nelson (who served August 1975-July 2001).

records.name: J. Kyle Dalpe
records.notes: Current president per WNC's official website; confirmed as president in 2024 news coverage of a nursing-program expansion and a community Rib Cook-Off event. Predecessor and exact appointment date not confirmed this session; wnc.edu's administration page returned a 404.

records.name: Zachary Z. Suarez
records.notes: Current president per Wikipedia (as of the article's last update in August 2026). Immediate predecessor could not be confirmed this session -- coastalbend.edu's Office of the President page repeatedly failed to load (redirect loops/errors). The college's Wikipedia history only documents its first president, Grady C. Hogue, who led the institution (then Bee County College) from its 1967 opening, leaving a large historical gap.

records.name: Grady C. Hogue
records.notes: First president of Bee County College (Coastal Bend College's predecessor institution), selected by the board of trustees; led the college when it opened in September 1967 with 790 students. Many decades separate his tenure from the current presidency; intervening presidents not identified this session.

records.name: Patricia B. Huber
records.notes: Current president since 2017; the fifth president of New River Community College and the first woman to hold the position, per Wikipedia. The names and tenures of the four prior presidents were not available in accessible sources this session; nr.edu's presidents-office and administration pages returned 404s.

records.name: Brent Bates
records.notes: Current president per SFCC's official website; brings 40 years of experience in higher education. Exact start date and whether he succeeded Joanna Anderson directly (who per Wikipedia served 2013-2022) were not confirmed this session; a Bing news search for his appointment returned no results.

records.name: Joanna Anderson
records.notes: Served as president 2013-2022, per Wikipedia's history section.

records.name: Marsha Drennon
records.notes: Served as president 2003-2013, per Wikipedia's history section.

records.name: Stephen Poort
records.notes: Served as president 1997-2003, per Wikipedia's history section.

records.name: Craig R. Lamb
records.notes: Became president in 2024, per Wikipedia and the college's Presidential Inauguration coverage on genesee.edu. Succeeded James M. Sunser.

records.name: James M. Sunser
records.notes: Served as president 2011-2024, per Wikipedia.

records.name: Stuart A. Steiner
records.notes: Led the institution for 36 years (1975-2011); the Stuart Steiner Theatre was named in his honor in 1991.

records.name: Cornelius V. Robbins
records.notes: Served as president 1970-1975, per Wikipedia.
